IN A DENSE FOREST LIVED A TORCHISE NAMED TESS WHO WANTED TO FLY. WHILE OTHER CREATURES SOARED OR HOPPED, TESS DREAMED OF SKY. SHE ASKED EVERY BIRD, “HOW DO YOU FLY?” BUT THEY LAUGHED. ONE DAY, SHE MET AN OWL WHO SAID, “FLYING REQUIRES COURAGE AND WINGS. YOU MUST BUILD YOUR OWN.”

TESS TOILED FOR MONTHS, CRAFTING WINGS FROM LEAVES AND FEATHERS. SHE PRACTICED CLIMBING MOUNTAINS TO GAIN HEIGHT. ONCE, SHE FELL BUT RISED AGAIN. A SQUIRREL HAD GIFTED HER A STRONG STRAP MADE OF VINE. WITH TIME, SHE LEARNED TO GLIDE SHORT DISTANCES. HER DETERMINATION GROWED STRONGER.

ON A WINDY DAY, TESS FLEW HIGHER THAN EVER, HER WINGS CATCHING THE BREEZE. SHE REACHED THE CLOUDS, FEELING FREEDOM. SHE CALLED TO THE OWL, “I DID IT!” THE OWL SMILED, “YOU TOOK THE PATH LESS TAKEN.”

MORAL: DREAM BIG, AND NEVER LET OBSTACLES STOP YOU. WITH PERSEVERANCE, YOU CAN ACHIEVE WHAT SEEMS IMPOSSIBLE.
